purpose: Compare early training stability at three learning rates.
established: All three ran 3,000 steps without going non-finite, covering the window where every lr=0.01 divergence occurred (steps 263-1011). So lr 0.001 is one workable choice, not a required one. This is a short-run stability screen; it says nothing about stability over a full run.
not_established: Any ranking among the three. The metrics are 40-record sampled values at 2.4% of the schedule, which is too small a sample to separate them.
cost: 3 x 3000 steps on one 4090, well under 1 GPU-hour
